# RZMPS GitHub Community Files

This folder contains the contribution process, issue templates, and pull request
templates for the RZMPS monorepo.

## Useful Files

- `CONTRIBUTING.md`: local setup, development workflow, and contribution
  expectations.
- `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`: community behavior expectations.
- `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`: templates for reporting bugs and requesting features.
- `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/`: templates for different contribution types.

## Before Opening an Issue

- Search existing issues and pull requests for related work.
- Check the relevant README:
  - Root `README.md` for the monorepo.
  - `packages/rzmps/README.md` for the core library.
  - `packages/demo/README.md` for the demo and preset authoring.
- Include a small reproduction whenever possible.

## Before Opening a Pull Request

- Keep the change focused.
- Run the relevant build or benchmark command.
- Update docs and presets when behavior changes.
- Mention any follow-up work that should not block the pull request.
